item.title: Geraldton welcomes the New Year with a peaceful night and laid-back day
item.description: Geraldton residents managed to ring in the New Year with maximum fun and minimum destruction, with no major incidents occurring in the region.

item.title: House fire in Rangeway leaves two families without a home in the New Year
item.description: A fire at a residential property in Rangeway has left two single mums and their children without accommodation in the new year.

item.title: Geraldton’s rising swimming stars prepare to take on regional rivals in Swimming WA Country Championships
item.description: Some of Geraldton’s youngest and most exciting swimming prospects will battle it out in the Swimming WA Country Championships held at the Perth HPC Centre, starting this Friday.

item.title: Year in Review: The local stories that grabbed our attention for good and bad reasons in final months of 2025
item.description: The local headlines that dominated the news in Geraldton in the final three months of 2025 certainly put an exclamation mark on the end of the year, for all manner of reasons.

item.title: Geraldton Water Polo Association round 11: B52’s set the benchmark as competition returns from Xmas hiatus
item.description: Round 11 of the Geraldton water polo season marks the first splash back after the festive break, with sunburn fading, Christmas pudding finally digested, and ladders starting to feel very real.

item.title: Geraldton Softball Association round 11: Suiside keen to put late season hiccup behind them in new year
item.description: Round 11 of Geraldton’s softball season looms as a classic post Christmas checkpoint. The legs may be fresh, the timing slightly off, but the intent will be very real as teams jostle for ladder position.

item.title: Wave Rally returns to Coronation Beach for another year, promising windier and wilder windsurfing action
item.description: The 2026 Wave Rally World Championships are shaping up to be windier and wilder than last year’s, with local and international windsurfers set to descend on Coronation Beach this weekend.

item.title: Geraldton’s junior swimmers shatter PBs and bring home healthy medal haul in Country Championships
item.description: Geraldton’s junior swimmers have shown positive signs and shattered personal bests left and right after a successful campaign at the Swimming WA Country Championships in Perth last weekend.

item.title: Kenneth John Giles: Police hunt underway for 58-year-old after woman shot at Mullewa property
item.description: A major police hunt involving the tactical response group and police aircraft is underway after a gunman fled the scene of a shooting in a WA town.

item.title: Kenneth John Giles: Who is the Mullewa gunman? Locals reveal concerns over alleged shooter’s state of mind
item.description: A Mullewa farmhand who allegedly shot his partner in the hand before fleeing police has been likened to a ‘dingo’ due to his extensive bush knowledge amid fears he has fled into WA’s outback with a gun.
